tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshul bzhi sngon du 'gro ba dang bcas pa'i kyai rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa'i don 'grel khog phub legs par bshad pa rgyud 'grel sgo brgya'i lde mig ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /dge'o// rgya gar skad du/ saddhe shwa ra badzra tsarya sya bandha naṃ kā ro mi/ bod skad du/ grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje slob dpon la gus pas phyag bgyi'o/ /zab rgyas rgyud sde kun gyi chu gter che/ /sa skya'i bla chen brgyud par bcas pa dang / /'brel tshad don ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /kho bo'i 'dren pa rnam gsum 'jam dbyangs sku mched dang / rgyal ba mus pa chen po/ rtag tu rgyal/ /rnam gzhag mtshan don bshad thabs mngon rtogs dang / /rtsa rgyud don 'grel khog phub dang bcas pa'i/ /legs bshad rgyud 'grel sgo brgya'i lde mig 'di/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan phyir 'dir spel lo/ /'jam dbyangs mched las rtsa rgyud lung nos shing / /rdo rje 'chang dbang mus pa chen po nas/ /legs 'ongs rgyud 'grel bshad bka' lung dang bcas/ /'khrul med brgyud ldan dag las nyer nos pa/ /bshad pa 'di la don gnyer dga' bas nyon/ /ces mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bcas nas/ 'dir dpal kye rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis kyi bdag nyid le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum shlau ka bdun brgya lnga bcu'i bdag nyid can 'di ni/ gang bshad par bya ba'i gzhung yin no/ /'di 'chad pa la/ spyir 'phags pa'i yul du 'grel byed ji ltar byung tshul/ de las gangs can gyi khrod 'dir dus nam byung zhing lam srol ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ de rnams kyi nang nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i lam srol ngos bzung zhing de nyid bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ brtag pa gnyis pa 'di la 'phags yul gyi 'grel par grags pa bcu gnyis yod de/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang pos/ dpal ldan brtag pa gnyis pa yi/ /rgyud kyi tshig don 'grel byed pa/

/rdo rje snying po nā ro pa/ /nag po spyod pa bha wa pa/ /ḍaṃ ga da sha padma ba/ /mi thub zla ba shanti pa/ /dam tshig rdo rje pad phyug dang / /ka ma dhe nu chos grags te/ /'phags yul 'grel byed bcu gnyis mthong / /ces gsungs pas so/ /chos grags kyi 'grel pa ni 'grel pa spyan 'byed ces bya ba zhig yod mod kyi/ bu ston sogs kyis zangs dkar lo tsā bas byas par bzhed pa don la yang gnas te/ 'on kyang chos grags 'grel pa ni/ bod mar mkhas pa 'ga' zhig bzhed/ /ces bshad pa'i phyir/ slob dpon gangs ri'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bka' 'grel yod kyang / sngon chad bod du ma 'gyur ro/ /de ltar rgya 'grel yin nges pa ni sngar gyi bcu gcig po rnams yin la/ de'i nang gi dang po rdo rje snying 'grel ni/ snga 'gyur la le'u lnga pa yan chad kyi 'grel pa yod pa de'i mdzad pa po ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po dngos yin la/ phyi 'gyur la 'grel pa tshang ma yod pa ni/ rdo rje snying po dang ming mthun pa'i paṇḍi ta gzhan zhig gis byas pa yin no gsungs/ nā ro 'grel chen ni/ bskyed rim mtsho skyes dang mthun pa/ rdzogs rim sbyor drug ltar bshad pa zhig yod do/ /kha cig 'di mdzad pa po grub chen nā ro par 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ 'grel pa de'i mjug tu/ kha che'i yul du skyes pa yi/ /dge slong snyan grags bzang pos sbyar/ /zhes pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /yang kha cig der stong nyid kyi lta ba bstan par 'dod pa ni gzhung de nyid la dpyad pa ma zhugs par zad do/ /nag po spyod pa bas byas pa'i dran pa'i 'byung gnas ni/ bskyed rim ye shes zhabs dang mthun pa/ rdzogs rim 'di yin rang med pa'i 'grel pa 'os tsam 'dug go zhes gsungs/ bha wa pa'i 'grel pa ni/ mu stegs sogs kyi 'dod tshul zhib tu ston pa zhig yod/ ḍaṃ ga da sha'i 'grel pa ni/ kha sbyor dri ma med pa zhes bya ba rgya cher bshad pa zhig yod la/

'di'i nang na rje btsun gong ma rnams dang mthun pa'i man ngag gi bshad pa yang mang du 'dug go /kha cig kha sbyor zhes pa'i ming la 'khrul nas/ sambu ṭa'i 'grel par byas pa ni 'di nyid ma mthong par zad do/ /'grel ba padma can ni/ grub chen mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa'i bskyed rim zab pa'i tshul dgu dang / rdzogs rim mar me'i rtse mo lta bu ston pa'o/ /mi thub zla ba'i dka' 'grel ku mu ti ni/ brtag pa gnyis pa'i brjod bya ku mu ti dang 'dra ste/ nyi ma shar ba na ku mu ta kha zum pa bzhin du mkhas pa gzhan rnams kyis rgyud kyi don kha dbye bar mi nus la/ slob dpon mi thub zla ba'i blo gros thos byung gi shes rab dri ma med pa ston kha'i nam mkhar mtshan mo'i dus kyi zla ba shar bas na ku mu ta kha 'byed pa bzhin du rgyud kyi tshig don mtha' dag kha 'byed la/ nyin mo'i dus su bung ba rnams kyis ku mu ta kha zum pa'i nang de khang par mthong nas sbrang rtsi bsags pa mtshan mo zla ba shar bas ku mu ta kha bye nas nang gi sbrang rtsi mtshan mo 'ba' zhig rgyu ba'i bya tsa go ra zhes pa'i tshogs kyis za ba bzhin du/ rgyud kyi don rim gnyis kyi sbrang rtsi tsa ko ra dang 'dra ba'i rjes su 'jug pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis len du 'jug pa mi thub zla ba kho na'i byed las yin pa'i phyir ku mu ta zhes btags te/ 'grel pa de nyid las/ thos pa'i ston ka 'byung ba'i dpal/ /sbyangs dka' zla ba ku mu ti/ /mkhas pa'i tsa kor tshogs kyis ni/ /bsod nams 'di ni btung bar mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi ta chen pos gsungs so/ /'di ni rje btsun rnal 'byor dbang phyug nas brgyud pa'i bshad pa'i tshul shin tu legs pa/ rang gi lugs la nye bar mkho ba'o/ /shānti pa'i mu tig phreng ba ni/ lta ba sems tsam du 'grel ba/ bskyed rim ye shes zhabs dang mthun pa/ rdzogs rim phyag rgya sogs dngos bstan tsam 'chad pa zhig yod do/

/dam tshig gi rdo rjes byas pa'i 'grel pa ni rin chen sbyor phreng zhes bya ba/ lta ba ma gtogs gzhan shānti pa dang mthun par bshad pa zhig yod ces gsungs/ padma'i myu gu ni mdzad pa po'i slob dpon padma'i myu gu'i rdo rje zhes bya bas mdzad pa des ming gis btags pa ste 'grel pa bsdus pa zhig yod ces gsungs/ ka ma dhe nu ni/ 'grel pa shin tu bsdus pa ste de rnams so/ /de dag ni mkhas pa'i dbang po mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams lhun grub dang / sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje gnyis kyi dgongs pa ltar bkod pa yin la/ yang rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun chos rje kun dga' blo gros kyis zin bris su byas pa las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ spyir kyai rdo rje la dus 'khor lugs su bshad pa/ gsang 'dus su bshad pa/ ma rgyud du bshad pa gsum/ dang po byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po'i 'grel pa lta spyod dus 'khor gyi lugs dang shin tu mthun/ dus 'khor ba rnams kyis bshad pa yang dag byas/ le'u lnga pa yan rdo rje snying po rang gis mdzad pa'ang yin/ de man 'gro zhes bya ba gcig gis byas pa yin tshod du 'dug le'u lnga pa yan la rje btsun yab sras 'di pa thugs rtsis shin tu che ba yin pas/ kho rang gi lugs kyi bshad pa re zur du mdzad/ yang dpyal se lo tsā bas bsgyur pa'i nā ro 'grel chen du grags pa de la/ kha cig nā ro ta pa chen pos sku tshe'i smad la mdzad par bzhed/ de ni ma yin te/ de nyid las/ kha che'i yul du skyes pa yi/ /dge slong snyan grags bzang pos sbyar/ /zhes bshad pas nā ro ta pa bgres dus dge slong gi brtul zhugs mi mdzad/ 'on kyang nā ro'i gdung brgyud cig yin pa srid/ de'i 'grel pa phal cher dus 'khor dang mthun pa la/ bskyed rim mtsho skyes dang 'dra/ gnyis pa gsang 'dus dang mthun pa la/ slob dpon shānti pa'i 'grel pa mu tig phreng ba/

sgrub thabs 'khrul spong / lta ba sems tsam dang mthun/ nyams len ye shes zhabs lugs ji bzhin yin/ slob dpon dam tshig rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'grel pa rin chen sbyor phreng zhes bya ba shānti pa'i de la bshus pa lta bu yin/ 'on kyang sems tsam bya ba la/ ngo bo nyid med bya ba yod/ yang nag po spyod pa chung ba'i 'grel pa dran pa'i 'byung gnas bya ba ye shes zhabs lugs dang shin tu mthun pa yin/ slob dpon bha wa bha dras mdzad pa'i 'grel pa zhig yod pa ma rgyud dang mthun pa yin te/ bshad pa legs kyang gdam ngag 'thon chung / slob dpon chos kyi grags pas mdzad par grags pa'i 'grel pa dka' ba'i spyan gcig bya ba zhig dang / nā ro pa'i gsung gi 'od zer bya ba gnyis bod kyis sbyar ba yin tshod 'dug slob dpon birwa pa'i bshad srol slob dpon ḍombhi ba las brgyud pa 'di la/ mi thub zla bas mdzad pa'i 'grel ba ku mu ti/ gzhung phran dang bcas pa 'di la rje btsun sa skya pa rnams tshad mar byed de 'chad pa yin no zhes 'byung ngo / /lam srol ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ bskyed rdzogs tshang bar ston pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed drug tsam zhig bod du 'gyur tshod dang bstun na byung bar gsal te/ mtsho skyes lugs kyi lam srol dang / nag po dam tshig rdo rje'i lugs dang / shānti pa lugs dang / nā ro pa'i lugs dang / mai tri pa'i lugs dang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi lugs te drug po 'di la bskyed rdzogs kyi lam gyi cha lag rdzogs par yod pas so/ /zhes rnam bshad zla zer las 'byung zhing / slob dpon de rnams kyis gzhung gang dang gang mdzad pa yang de nyid las 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa de las gangs can gyi khrod 'dir dus nam byung zhing lam srol ji ltar byung ba la/ bstan pa snga dar dang / phyi dar gnyis las/ snga dar gyi dus su ni/ kyai rdo rje'i chos skor rnams dar rgyas su ma byung la/

phyi dar la stod nas dar ba dang / smad nas dar ba gnyis las/ stod nas dar ba la rgyas par ma byung zhing / smad nas dar ba la/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba chen po shākya ye shes kyis rje gā ya dha ra dang lo paṇa du bsdebs nas kyai rdo rje rtsa bshad kyi 'gyur mdzad cing dar rgyas su mdzad pa la kyai rdo rje 'brog mi lugs zhes grags/ 'di la yang 'brog mi'i sku tshe'i stod la 'grel pa ku mu ti rang 'gyur du byas nas bshad de yab kyi bshad srol dang / 'brog jo sras rdo rje rnal 'byor rin po che'i sbyor 'phreng bsgyur nas bshad de/ sras kyi bshad srol zhes grags/ bla ma 'brog rje btsun gā ya dha ra dang mjal nas rgyud kyang man ngag gi bshad pa kho na la gtso bor mdzad cing / bshad pa'i rgyud la'ang gā ya dha ra'i gsung gtso bor mdzad pa yin no/ /zhes zha ma lugs kyi kyai rdo rje'i chos 'byung las bshad do/ /yang de dang dus mtshungs par 'gos lo tsā ba bsod nams rtse mos kyai rdo rje rtsa bshad rnams bsgyur cing dar bar mdzad de kyai rdo rje mgos lugs su grags so/ /yang bla ma mar pa lo tsā bas nā ro pa nas brgyud pa'i kyai rdo rje la ba pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud rnams bsgyur cing bshad pa la ni mar lugs su grags so/ /dus phyis dpyal lo tsā ba kun dga' rdo rjes paṇḍi ta 'jigs med grags pa las kyai rdo rje rtsa bshad rnams gsan nas dar bar mdzad pa la ni kyai rdo rje dpyal lugs zhes grags te lugs kyi gtso bo ni 'di dag yin la/ gzhan yang rwa sa dang / ram sdings ma sogs la bshad pa'i lugs srol mang du byung ngo / /de rnams kyi nang nas 'brog mi dang mgos lugs ni gā ya dha ra'i rjes 'brangs yin pas rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi lugs su 'du la/ mar lugs dang dpyal ni nā ro pa'i lugs su 'du bas bod du grags che ba'i kyai rdo rje'i bshad srol ni/ birwa pa'i lugs dang /

nā ro pa'i lugs gtso che ba yin no/ /gsum pa de rnams kyi nang nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i lam srol ngos bzung zhing de nyid bshad pa la gsum ste/ spyir bka' bab kyi byung tshul dang / bye brag tu rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi lam srol ngos bzung ba dang / des rgyud ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la kyai rdo rje'i bka' bab bzhi mnga' ba'i tshul/ rje btsun chen pos/ snying po don gyi kye rdor ni/ /birwa'i rjes 'brang ḍombhi'i skor/ /yan lag med ces padma'i skor/ /dam tshig rdo rje nag po'i skor/ /gtso che'i chos sna sum cu dgu/ /lam skor dgu ni khyad par ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i ḍombhi ba'i lugs grub chen dpa' bo rdo rje nas brgyud de 'brog mi dang / mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po dang / 'khon sgyi chu ba shākya 'bar gyi bar du byung la/ des rje sa skya pa chen po la gdams pa'o/ /padma'i lugs ni grub chen de nas ind+ra bhu ti dang / lakṣ+mīṃ ka ra dang / nag po spyod pa ba dang / bram ze dpal 'dzin dang / gā ya dha ra dang / 'brog mi dang / se ston dang / zhang dgon pa ba rnams las brgyud de rje sa chen la gdams pa'o/ /nag po dam tshig rdo rje'i rjes su 'brang ba nag po shānti bha dra'i lugs ni/ slob dpon de nyid nas rje mgos lo tsā ba/ des bla ma mnga' ris pa/ des 'khon sgyi chu ba/ des sa skya pa chen po la gdams pa'o/ /gsum po 'di'i khongs su 'dren pa'i gtso che'i chos sna sum cu dgu ni/ lho pa kun mkhyen gyi chos rje pa'i rnam thar du/ ḍombhi ba'i skor bcu dgu/ mtsho skyes kyi skor bdun/ nag po pa'i skor bco lnga ste zhe gcig las/ lhan cig skyes grub dang / mtsho skyes kyi bskyed rdzogs gnyis logs su bor bas so dgu bzhed par gsal la/ rje btsun gyi dkar chag tu 'di ltar gsungs te/ brtag pa gnyis pa la 'grel pa ku mu ti/

dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzang po yongs bzung / sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje gur gyi sgrub thabs/ gtum mo'i 'grel chung / sbyin sreg phyag mtshan gyi dag pa/ gtor ma/ sngags don/ yang sngags don/ bdud rtsi 'od/ lhan cig skyes grub/ lam gyi yan lag la/ de nyid bcu pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ dran pa gcig pa/ dpa' bo gcig pa/ rin chen 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs/ man ngag gi ro sreg kyang yin/ de rnams ḍombhi ba'i skor ro bco brgyad do/ brtag pa gnyis pa la 'grel pa padma can/ dkyil chog nas gling ma/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes rdo rje/ tshogs 'khor dam tshig lnga pa bstod pa de rnams padma'i skor lnga/ ro/ /gur gyi bshad sbyar/ phyag bcu drug pa dkar po/ skabs kyi 'grel pa brgyad de/ de ni gleng gzhi 'grel po rtse'i mngon rtogs chung ba dur khrod kyi 'grel pa chen po/ chung ba/ brda'i 'grel pa/ rdo rje glu'i 'grel pa chen po gcig chung ba'o/ /de rnams rje rin po che 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyi'o gsum/ /brtag pa gnyis pa la 'grel pa rnal 'byor rin po che sbyor ba'i phreng ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gzhung 'grel/ sgrub thabs de nyid gsal ba/ phyag bcu drug pa dpa' bo gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa dpa' bo gcig pa/ lam gyi yan lag la/ rab gnas tshul zab mo/ sbyin sreg ro sreg tshogs 'khor/ bstod pa/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs che chung gnyis/ rdzogs rim gyi gzhung / de rnams nag chung gi 'gos khug pa la brgyud pa'o bcu gsum/ /kyai rdo rje'i chos skor gtso che bar gsungs pa rnams so/ /zhes gsungs la/ de ltar na ḍombhi ba'i skor bco brgyad/ padma'i skor lnga/ 'brog ma'i skor gsum/ nag po'i skor bcu gsum ste so dgu'o/ /bka' bab bzhi pa ni/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug nas/ rje sa skya pa chen po'i bar du snyan brgyud 'bab zhig gis bzhugs pa gsung ngag dang lhan cig tu byung ba'i man ngag lugs kyi bshad pa'i srol 'di nyid do/

/gnyis pa bye brag tu rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi lam srol ngos bzung ba la gnyis te/ brgyud pa'i rim pa ji ltar 'byung ba dang / de la brten pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ ring brgyud/ nye brgyud dang / dang po la 'grel pa lugs dang / man ngag lugs gnyis las/ 'grel pa lugs ni/ rje btsun chen pos/ gnyis pa ḍombhi he ru ka dpal de rjes su/ /a la la dang dpal ldan nags khrod garbha ri/ /rgyal ba dpal gyi ye shes sbyang dka' zla ba dang / /dpa' bo rdo rjes ye shes zhabs la gdams pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ birwa pa yan chad 'dra ba'am/ yang na ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon ḍombhi he ru ka grub thob a la la badzra/ dpal ldan nags khrod pa garbha ri pa/ bsod snyoms pa dza ya shrī/ slob dpon sbyang dka' zla ba/ de la slob ma'i mchog dpa' bo rdo rje/ seng ge rdo rje/ sgra gcan 'dzin dang gsum las/ 'dir dge slong dpa' bo rdo rje/ des lo tsā ba chen po shākya ye shes la gnang / de la slob ma mchog bzhi ste/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ se mkhar chung pa kun rig khyin lo tsā ba 'od kyi snang ba rnams las/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ des sa skya pa chen po/ yang na bla ma mnga' ris pa/ 'khon sgyi chu ba dgra lha 'bar/ sa skya pa chen po/ yang na 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ se mkhar chung pa/ zhang ston chos 'bar/ rje sa chen/ yang na khyin lo tsā ba/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ rje sa skya pa chen po ste/ ma dros ye shes zhabs las rgyun bzhi'i bla ma ni/ /rgyal po rig dang snying po snang ba'i mtha' can te/ /rig dang snying po zhabs las 'bar ba 'bar ba'i mtha'/ /rgyun bzhi 'dzin pa'i bla chen de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes bshad pa ltar ro/ /de rnams kyi nang nas kyang rgyud kyi bshad pa sgyi chu ba'i lugs la gtso bor mdzad de/

bla ma mnga' ris pas rgyud dang 'grel pa dang / sgrub thabs rnams cha re bshad pa la khrab bzang ba re dgos pa la sgyi chu bas zhing khal lnga dang / khang pa nyis thog chung ngu gcig yod pa dus gcig la phul bas mnyes nas gzhung lugs thams cad rdzogs par bshad/ des sa chen la rdzogs par gnang zhing / dang po 'brog mi'i rgyud man ngag so sor bshad pas mi rabs gcig tsam nas rje sa skya pa la gnyis ka tshogs nas mnga' bdag tu thal bas 'brog mi de nyid skye ba bzhes pa yin no zhes kyang kha cig zer/ gang ltar yang rdo rje 'chang gi sprul pa zhig yin par 'dra ba gda'o/ /zhes pradzñā dzwa las rgyud kyi lo rgyus su gsungs pas so/ /de ltar brgyud pa'i bka' bab bzhi dang ldan pa'i bla ma sa skya pa chen pos/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ zhang tshul khrims grags/ gnyan phul phyung ba gtsug tor rgyal po dang gsum la gnang / de gsum kas rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan la/ des chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po la/ des 'phags pa la/ des dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal la/ des chos rje brag phub pa bsod nams dpal la/ des dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang / bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ des gnyis ka la bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ des chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des rje btsun kun dga' bzang po/ des paṇṭi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ des mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ des sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ des bstan pa'i gsal byed sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des sras kyi thu bo 'jam dbyangs sku mched rnams/ rim par brgyud de bshad lung gi rgyun ma nyams pa da lta yang bzhugs so/ /yang man ngag lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun rin po ches/ rje btsun chos skyong mthu stobs dbang phyug birwa pa/ /nag po ḍā ma ru dang a ba dhu ti pa/ /rje btsun gā ya dha ra shākya ye shes mchog

/ces gsungs te/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni sa paṇa yan gsung ngag dang 'dra la/ des 'phags pa/ des zhang dkon mchog dpal/ des rgyal ba bsod nams dpal/ des 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ des bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims pa/ des shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ des paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ des mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ des sa lo 'jam dbyangs chen po/ des paṇa chen nam mkha' dbang phyug des chos kyi rje bka' bcu pa grags pa mtha' yas/ des khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ dam pa de nyid kyis gling kha bde ba can du rtsa rgyud kyis bshad pa shin tu rgyas shing zhib pa lan gcig dang / dus phyis dben gnas bsam gtan phur lan gcig ste rgyud bshad lan gnyis gnang ba'i phyi ma'i dus su gsan pa'i chos rje nags dgon pa sbyin pa grags pa zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa'i brgyud ldan yid ches can nyid las/ dpal sa skya ba sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bdag gis don gnyer che cher bgyis te/ rtsa rgyud kyi bshad pa rje btsun gyi 'grel pa dag ldan dang / shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi dag ldan go sla gnyis kyi steng nas tshul bzhin sngon du 'gro ba dang bcas thob pa lags so/ /de ltar rje btsun mus chen nas brgyud pa'i rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis rkyang pa'i bshad pa rje nags dgon pa las thob pa'i rjes su/ dus phyis brtag gnyis/ rdo rje gur/ sambhu ṭa dang bcas pa'i kye rdor rgyud gsum ga'i bshad pa tshul bzhi sngon du 'gro ba dang bcas pa'i sgo nas zhib cing mtha' chod par mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyi drung du thos pa'i brgyud pa ni sa lo chen po yan gong dang 'dra ba las/ de nas rje e waṃ pa chen po dkon mchog lhun grub/ chos rje kun dga' mchog ldan/

mkhas pa'i dbang po klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ de'i drung du sa skya pa a nanda bdag gis thos shing / de dus sngon 'gro tshul bzhi dang rgyud gsum ga la don 'grel zin bris 'chad bde ba re byas yod/ gnyis pa nye brgyud ni/ rje btsun chen po'i stong thun sa bcad las/ bla med phyogs ni ris bsgyur mig bcas pa/ /rig byed kyis gsal lag pas me la bgo /de 'og kun gsal chu gter 'byung bar bcas/ /blo ldan don 'di shes na smra bar gyis/ /legs 'ong mig gis yon tan gsal bar byas/ /me dang chu bos 'byung ba rab tu bskyed/ /zla bas kun kyang gsal bar byed mod kyis/ /mig gis lags par bltas pa'i bdag blo dad/ /gzugs gnyis yon tan zung de thog ma ste/ /gang gis gang ston lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ gzhung 'di kun tu bltas pas blo ldan gyis/ /legs rtogs gzhan la ston na bdag blo spro/ /legs 'ongs 'chad pa bshad bzhi'i lo rgyus dang / /rnam 'grel bcas pas sdig 'joms gzhan mi ldan/ /mkha' mtshungs 'dzin bcas dri ma kun spangs te/ /yi ge bzhi ldan nyid du 'gyur bar shog /ces gsungs te/ 'di'i don la shlau ka dang po tsam ma gtogs gzhan rnams kyi bshad pa dngos su gsungs pa ma thos kyang / bla ma chos kyi rje'i bshad dpe la yod pa'i mchan rnying ltar bshad na bzhi ste/ brgyud pa'i rim pa dngos/ des rgyud ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul/ 'chad tshul de gzhan las khyad par 'phags par bstan/ bshad pa'i dge ba sku bzhir bsngo ba'o/ /dang po la'ang gnyis te/ rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis spyi'i brgyud pa dang / bye brag tu rgyud gsum po nyid gsal bar mdzad pa'i nye brgyud do/ /dang po ni bla med sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ bla med ni rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud sde/ phyogs ni bcu/ de ris bsgyur bas na bdun cu/ mig ni gnyis te bdun cu rtsa gnyis so/ /rig byed ni bzhi ste sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang ngo /

/lag pa ni brgyud pa gnyis pa bdag med ma/ me ni gsum gyis mtshon pa'i brgyud pa gsum pa birwa pa/ de'i gsung gi 'od zer kun tu gsal ba chu gter te bzhi pa rje btsun sa skya pa chen po dang / 'byung ba ste lnga pa rje btsun sku mched la bab pa'o/ /kye blo ldan rnams brgyud tshul 'di lta bu brda tshig gis bstan pa'i don shes na smra bar gyis shig ces bod cing bskul ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ legs 'ongs sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ legs 'ongs brgyud pa'i rim pa yin la/ mig ni brgyud pa gnyis pa rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'o/ /yon tan ni gsum pa birwa pa ste/ de'i rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing gsal bar byas pa'o/ /me ni gsum pa birwa pa dang / chu bo ni bzhi pa sa skya ba chen po ste/ de gnyis kas 'byung ba ste rje btsun sku mched gnyis kyi yon tan rab tu bskyed ces pa'o/ /'di ni birwa pa nyid kyis rje btsun sku mched la dngos su gsungs pa yang gsal bar grub ste/ gsung bgros gzhan las/ mthu stobs dbang phyug yi dam gang rung la/ /nyin mtshan gang yang the tshom gcod mdzad pa/ /zhes dang / 'o na yang rje btsun rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis bag tsam rjes su bzung ngam snyam pa gcig byung / zhes bshad pas so/ /rkang pa phyi ma gnyis kyi don ni/ zla ba ste rdo rje 'chang chen pos rgyud kyi don mtha' dag gsal bar byed pa yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang rgyud kyi don rnams ni man ngag dang mi ldan pas rtogs par mi nus te/ ji skad du/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' ni rgya mtsho bzhin/ /zab cing gting dpag dka' la thug pa med/ /rdo rje theg pa'ang dgongs pa sna tshogs pas/ /gsung shing rdo rje'i tshig gis rgyas btab pas/ /zhes bshad pa ltar ro/ /man ngag dang ldan pas ni bde blag tu rtogs par nus te/ lung bstan grub pa klu sgrub la sogs sam/ /mkha' 'gros byin brlabs birwa pa la sogs/

/grub thob rnams kyi gsung rab la brten nas/ /rjes 'jug skye bos bka' rnams rtogs par 'gyur/ /zhes bshad pa ltar ro/ /de bas na mig ste brgyud pa gnyis pa rdo rje bdag med mas legs par bltas shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birwa pa'i brgyud pa 'di la sangs rgyas nas brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i man ngag gi bshad tshul yod pa'i phyir/ bdag gi blo shin tu dad ces pa'o/ /spyi don gnyis pa des rgyud ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul ni/ gzugs zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ gzugs ni phung po lnga'i dang po yin pa ltar gcig gi brda tshig yin la/ de gnyis ni gzugs gnyis te tshul dang po gnyis so/ /yon tan ni gsum gyi brda tshig yin la/ de zung ni drug ste tshul gsum pa gdams ngag drug go /thog ma ni tshul dang po gsum sngon du song ba'o/ /rgyud gang gis mngon par rtogs pa gang ston pa'i lo rgyus ni mngon rtogs te/ de dang bcas pa'i tshul bzhi po gzhung rgyud gsum po 'dir spyi don gyi kun tu bltas pas blo gros dang ldan pa'i gang zag rnams kyis rgyud kyi don legs par rtogs par 'gyur la/ rtogs pa de nyid gzhan la ston na bdag gi blo gros kyang spro zhes dgyes pa skyed pa'i tshig go /spyi don gsum pa 'chad tshul de gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa ni/ legs 'ongs sogs rkang pa gnyis te/ legs 'ongs ni brgyud pa'i rim pa yin la/ de las byung ba'i rgyud 'chad thabs kyi tshul dang po gsum dang bshad gzhi rgyud gsum gyi lo rgyas can ni mngon par rtogs pa ste tshul bzhi sngon du song nas rgyud so so'i rnam 'grel bsdus don dang bcas pa sdig pa'i dri ma ma lus pa 'joms shing yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba rgyas par byed pas na gzhan la mi ldan pa'i khyad chos yin zhes pa ste/ rnam bshad las/ de ltar bshad pa'i rnam gzhag de dag kun/

/gsang sngags 'dzin pa gzhan la ma grags shing / /'ga' zhig grags kyang ji bzhin mi shes pas/ /lugs 'di gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa yin/ /zhes bshad pa dang mthun no/ /bzhi pa bshad pa'i dge ba sku bzhir bsngo ba ni/ mkha' mtshungs sogs rkang pa gnyis te/ nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa ni dmigs pa med pa'i thabs shes rab zung du 'jug pa chos kyi sku nyid yin te/ ji skad du/ dmigs med gnas su shes rab dang / /dmigs med snying rje chen po nyid/ /blo dang lhan cig gcig gyur pa/ /nam mkhar nam mkha' ji lta ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /'dzin pa dang bcas pa'i dri kun spangs pa ni gnas gyur pa'i yon tan mthar thug pa brnyes pa ste/ de ni shrī he ru ka zhes pa yi ge bzhi'i don dang ldan pa ste/ sku bzhi'i bdag nyid yin la de nyid du 'gyur bar shog cig ces bsngo ba'o/ /spyi don gnyis pa de la brten pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs bshad pa la/ man ngag gi skabs su dgos pa dang / rgyud 'chad pa la dgos ba gnyis las/ dang po ni gzhan du gsal la/ 'dir rgyud 'chad pa la dgos pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la gnyis te/ 'dir cis kyang dgos pa dang / zhar byung rgyud 'grel gyi rnam grangs bshad pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ rgyud spyi la dgos pa/ rgyud so so la dgos pa/ rdo rje theg pa spyi dang rgyud 'di'i rnal 'byor pa spyi la dgos pa/ sbas pa'i brtul zhugs la dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyud sde'i dum bu rnam gzhag mngon rtogs dang / /stong thun rnams kyi don bsdus bstod pa gnyis/ /bdag med bstod pa'i rnam 'grel dang bcas pa/ /kun tu dgos pa'i gzhung bdun 'thor mi bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ rgyud sde'i dum bu ni rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa brgya dang bcu gsum pa dang / brgya lnga bcu pa zhes pa yod la/ 'di gnyis la lung 'bum zhes kyang grags so/ /de yang rtsa rgyud dang / rdo rje gur gyi lung bsdus pa rnams la ni/

rgyud kyi dum bu zhes 'byung la/ sambu ṭi'i lung rnams la ni rgyud sde'i dum bu zhes 'byung ba 'thad do zhes bla ma dag gsungs so/ /'di dag gi lung gi grangs la brgya dang bcu gsum pa ltar na rgyud thams cad kyi sgra don mdor bsdus te brjod pa la lung gnyis/ rgyu rgyud la lung nyi shu/ thabs rgyud la lung brgyad bcu gya gcig 'bras rgyud la lung bcu ste/ de ltar na mngon rtogs yan chad la lung brgya dang bcu gsum mo/ /yang brgya dang lnga bcu pa ltar na/ dbang man chad la lung nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ thabs rgyud la lung brgyad cu gya drug 'bras rgyud la lung bcu/ tshul lhag ma gsum la nyer brgyad de/ lung brgya lnga bcu'o/ /grangs 'di rnams ni yi ge rnying pa rnams na mchan bu dang grangs yig btab 'dug pa ji lta bar bris pa'o/ /rgyud sde'i dum bu 'di la rje btsun chen po'i sa bcad kyang yod do/ /yang dus phyis shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas kyis zhib tu gtan la phab pa'i lung 'bum zhig kyang yod do zhes grag go /rnam gzhag ni rgyud sde spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa yod la/ 'di la yi ge rnying pa rnams su don 'dra ba la rgyas bsdus ci rigs su yod pa 'ga' zhig 'dug go /yang rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos rgyud sde spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa rgyud ma lus pa la 'jug pa rnal 'byor gyi mig ces pa mtshan gyi rnam grangs bzhi dang ldan pa zhig mdzad la/ 'di la yang dang po'i dus su sa bcad dkyus la ma bris shing / tshul gsum ka la skabs bdun du phye nas le'u gsum du ma bcad pa zhig yod la/ phyis chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta chen pos rje btsun rin po che'i bka' gnang ba bzhin du sa bcad dkyus la bcug cing tshul gsum la le'u gsum du phye/ le'u dang po rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag la skabs bdun du phye ba zhig mdzad nas/ rje btsun chen po la gzigs pa phul nas mjug tu yang /

mkha' 'gro'i dbang po dpag yas nam mkha' la/ /lding ba'i mtshan ma rjes su mthong gyur nas/ /sbrang rtsi 'dzin pa padma'i rtsa lag dang / /ldan pa de yis rjes su brtson pa legs/ /zhes bris pa yod de/ 'di ni shin tu legs pas da lta'i bar gyi bla ma rnams kyi phyag dpe yang 'di la mdzad do/ /mngon rtogs ni/ sa skya pa chen po yan chad kyis mngon par rtogs pa'i yi ge chung ngu zhig kyang yod la/ sa chen nyid kyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs yod ces gsungs pa ni rgyud kyi dum bu nyid du mngon par rtogs pa'i lung rnams bsdus pas na de nyid la zer te/ ljon shing las/ mngon par rtogs pa'i yi ge bla ma gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pa'i phyir/ bdag gi bla mas rgyud kyi lung rnams gsungs pa bzhin phyogs gcig tu bsdebs te cung zad gsal bar mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na rgyud mngon rtogs su slong ba zhes pa'i mngon rtogs yi ge nyung ngu logs na yod pa de sa chen gyis mdzad pa ma yin no/ /yang gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs kyi don gsal bar bya ba'i phyir dang / slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mos bka' gnang ba la brten nas/ rje btsun rin po ches rgyud gsum ka'i mngon par rtogs pa phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa rin po che ljon shing mdzad do/ /'di yi yang lta ba rim can gyi skabs yan chad ni rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa yin te/ ljon shing las/ kho bos 'bad de legs par sbyar ba yi/ /mngon par rtogs pa rin chen ljon shing las/ /thun mong blta ba rim pa can gyi skabs/ /'di ni bla ma dam pas gsal bar mdzad/ /ces bshad pas so/ /yang de nyid la sa bcad dkyus su bcug cing zhu dag legs par mdzad pa ni chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po yin zhing / mjug tu yang thub pa'i dgongs pa me tog gi phreng ba bla ma'i gsung zer gyis/ /phye 'di 'gro ba'i spyi gtsug na/

/zla zer bzhin du mdzes par shog /ces bris pa yod de/ 'di la phyag dpe'i gtso bo mdzad do/ /stong thun rnams kyi don bsdus ni/ stong thun sa bcad du grags pa tshul bzhi'i sa bcad rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa 'di yin la/ chos rje pas mdzad pa zhig kyang yod do/ /bstod pa gnyis ni yab kyi bstod pa daṇḍi ka dang / yum gyi bstod pa dri ma med pa dang gnyis so/ /mchan kha cig las/ bdag med ma'i bstod pa rgyas bsdus gnyis zhes 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ de ltar na don bsdus te bstod pa dang gsum du thal ba'i skyon 'byung bas so/ /bdag med bstod pa'i rnam 'grel ni/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas mdzad pa ste bdun po 'di ni rgyud 'chad pa'i gnas skabs kun tu dgos pas 'thor bar mi bya'o/ /gnyis pa rgyud so so la dgos pa ni/ rgyud don so so'i rnam 'grel don bsdus bcas/ /gang la gang dgos de de blang bya zhing / /de ltar bcu gsum legs par rab bltas na/ /rnam par phye bas rgyud gsum shes par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ de la rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa ni gdul bya blo gros rab 'bring tha gsum gyi rim pa la dgongs nas/ sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i dka' 'grel man ngag don gsal dang / rje btsun rtse mo'i nyi ma'i 'od zer dang / rje btsun chen po'i rnam bshad dag ldan dang gsum yod la/ rdo rje gur la sa chen gyis bshad pa'i chings dang / le 'grel sogs yig chung thor bu ba mang du yod cing / rje btsun chen pos rnam bshad gur rgyan mdzad do/ /sambu ṭi la sa chen gyis dka' 'grel dang / rgyud phyi ma'i 'grel chung gnyis mdzad la/ rje btsun rtse mos rnam bshad gnad kyi gsal byed mdzad cing / 'di'i mjug cung zad tsam rje btsun chen pos kha bskangs so/ /yang rgyud gsum so so'i don bsdus kyang / rtsa rgyud la sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i sa bcad dang / rtse mos mdzad pa dang / rje btsun gyis mdzad pa dag ldan du 'byung ba dang /

rtse mos mdzad pa gnyis ka la cung zad tsam tshig gi sna bsrings pa sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa ste gsum yod la/ rdo rje gur la rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i sa bcad yod do/ /sambu ṭi la rtse mos mdzad pa'i sa bcad/ rje btsun gyis zhu dag legs par mdzad pa yod do/ /bcas zhes pa dang / gang la gang dgos zhes pa'i tshig gi shugs la gzhung gi don phra mo rnams mchan bus bkral pa yang bstan te/ de yang sa chen gyi dka' 'grel las/ gzhung gi don rnams ni mchan du legs par btab la/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rtsa ba'i rgyud la sa chen gyi mchan bu yod cing / rdo rje gur la rje btsun gyi mchan bu zhib mo dang / sambu ṭi la/ mnga' ris pa dang / sa chen dang / sa paṇa gsum ka'i mchan bu yod do/ /de ltar so sor phye na mang du yod kyang 'dir ni rgyud gsum gyi rnam 'grel dang / don bsdus gnyis gnyis su phye nas rgyud gcig shes par 'dod na gnyis dang / gnyis shes par 'dod na bzhi dang / gsum shes par 'dod na drug bltas pas rgyud gsum shes par 'gyur zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa rdo rje theg pa spyi dang rgyud 'di'i rnal 'byor pa spyi la dgos pa ni/ smin byed ltung ba'i rnam bshad sgrub thabs bzhi/ /rab gnas sbyin bsreg tshogs kyi cho gar bcas/ /rdo rje dril bu bgrang phreng dgang blug dang / /tha ma'i cho ga mchod rten bsgrub pa ste/ /de ltar bcu bzhi dang po'i las can nas/ /brtsams te gang zag kun gyis gzung bar bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ de la smin byed ni dbang gi chu bo rgyas pa rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa/ dbang gong ma gsum gyi yi ge logs na yod pa dang bcas pa'o/ /ltung ba'i rnam bshad ni rtsa ba'i ltung ba 'khrul pa spong pa rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'o/ /sgrub thabs bzhi ni yab kyi sgrub thabs yan lag bzhi pa rtse mos mdzad pa dang / drug pa rje btsun gyis mdzad pa gnyis dang / yum gyi sgrub thabs rje btsun gyis mdzad pa gcig nyid la yan lag bzhi drug gnyis ka sbyar bas bzhi'am/

yang na yum gyi sgrub thabs gcig tu bgrangs nas rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i phyi bskyed rim bsdus pa/ nang bskyed rim dang 'brel pa can du sgom pa'i sgrub thabs de dang bzhi'o/ /zhes paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan gsungs so/ /rab gnas ni rgyud kyis ngos bstan rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg ni rtse mos mdzad pa'i zhi ba dang / de'i kha skong rje btsun gyis mdzad pa ste yig sna gcig tu bgrang ngo / /tshogs 'khor ni rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i tshogs 'khor 'bring pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu'i yig cha logs na med kyang / gnad kyi gsal byed kyi nang du gsal bar bshad pa'i skabs de nyid do/ /'ga' zhig rje btsun gyis mdzad do zhes zer ba'i rdo rje dril bu'i don de kho na nyid ston pa'i yi ge zhig 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ rje btsun gyi dngos slob bla ma dbyil sgom gyis mdzad pa'i khrid kyi tho yig las/ rje btsun chen po'i zhal nas rdo rje dril bu'i mngon par rtogs pa gcig byed pa yin pa la ma grub pa gsungs kyang / sambhu ṭi na 'dug pa'i rdo rje dril bu'i rgyud dang / tshad dang / dkrol thabs dang / zhes pa der blta zhing 'dir shes par bya'o/ /zhes bshad pas so/ /bgrang phreng yang sambhu ṭi dang / gur du 'byung ba ltar ro/ /dgang blug gi yig cha yang logs na med kyang / rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos bzang po yongs gzung gi mchan bur bshad pa dang / rje btsun gyi las bzhi'i sbyin sreg tu mdor bsdus tsam 'byung ba las rtogs par bya'o/ /tha ma'i cho ga ni rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i gzhan phan bdud rtsi 'od/ mchod rten sgrub pa ni rnam bshad gur rgyan du 'byung ba ltar ro/ /de ltar bcu bzhi po de ni rnal 'byor pa las dang po pa nas brtsams te rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa'i bar gyi gang zag kun gyis kyang gzung bar bya zhes pa'o/ /bzhi pa sbas pa'i brtul zhugs la dgos pa ni/

lus rgyan ltung ba'i snod dang gzung bya'i rdzas/ /rol mo'i cho ga stan dang bgo ba gos/ /'di dag he ru ka dpal chas drug ste/ /rnam par phye na bcu bzhir 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ de yang bcu bzhir 'gyur tshul ni/ lus rgyan la khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu/ rus rgyan dang bzhi/ btung ba'i snod la thod pa/ gzung bya'i rdzas la kha ṭwaṃ ga dang / gri gug gnyis/ rol mo la ḍā ma ru dang / gsang ba'i rnga chung dang / dung chen gyi gling bu ste gsum/ stan la mi ro'i gdan dang / stag lpags kyi gdan gnyis/ gos la mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang / stag lpags kyi sham thabs gnyis te bcu bzhi'o/ /yang gzhung 'ga' zhig las rnam par phye na bzhi bcur 'gyur ba yin/ zhes 'byung ba ltar na/ sngar gyi yig cha'i grangs de rnams kyi steng du/ he ru ka'i chas drug la bcu gsum du phye bas bzhi bcur 'gyur ba yin te/ chas drug la bcu gsum du 'byed tshul ni/ lus rgyan la gcig snod la gcig /gzung bya'i rdzas la rdo rje dril bu/ bgrang phreng / dgang blug kha ṭwaṃ ga dang bzhi/ rol mo'i cho ga la sngar ltar gsum/ stan la gcig gos la mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi/ glang chen gyi ko rlon/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs te bcu gsum mo/ /'on kyang snga ma 'di legs te/ rje btsun gyis/ rgyan la bzhi dang btung ba'i snod la lnga/ /lag cha gnyis dang rol mo'i cha byad gsum/ /stan dang gos la gnyis gnyis de ltar na/ /drug las phye ba'i rnam grangs bcu bzhi'o/ /zhes bshad pa'o/ /spyi don gnyis pa zhar byung rgyud kyi 'grel pa'i rnam grangs bshad pa la/ 'phags yul gyi 'grel pa'i rnam grangs ni gong du bshad zin la/ bod du byung ba la lugs mang du yod kyang / 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa'i lugs dang mthun pa'i rgyud 'grel gyi rnam grangs ni/ gong ma gsum gyi sngon du byung ba dang / gong ma gsum gyis mdzad pa dang /

de'i rjes su byung ba'i rnam grangs te gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ bla ma chos kyi rjes/ bod na ram rngog dpyal se sogs/ /bshad pa'i bka' srol mang na yang / /mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan sa skya pa'i/ /lugs la bla ma mnga' ris pa/ /gsal ba'i snying po'i tshig 'grel dang / /sgyi chu ba yi dka' 'grel yod/ /ces gsungs te bla ma mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying pos rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi 'bru shin tu zhib par bshad pa'i 'grel pa 'di ni 'brog mi lugs kyi 'grel pa rnams kyi dang po yin la/ 'khon sgyi chu ba shākya 'bar gyis kyang dka' 'grel zhig mdzad de 'di gnyis ni lung gi rgyun yod pa dang 'gros mthun pas na sa skya pa'i bka' 'bum rnams su yang bzhugs yod do/ /kha cig gis dag 'grel 'di dang / sa chen gyi ṭika chung nor ba yod de zhib tu ma dpyad pa'o/ /yang bla ma se mkhar chung bas mdzad pa'i dka' 'grel nyung ngu zhig kyang rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos gzigs so zhes mi nyag pradzña dzwa la gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rje btsun sa chen yab sras kyi/ /dka' 'grel nyi 'od dag ldan gsum/ /spyi rnam rgyud kyi mngon rtogs sogs/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i gzhung bdun yod/ /ces gsungs te/ bdun po ni gong du bshad zin la/ de rnams dang khyad par med pa ni/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po'i dngos kyi slob ma dge slong pradzña dzwa las mdzad pa'i spyi rnam dka' 'grel dang bcas pa dang / rdo rje gur gyi dka' 'grel dang / sambhu ṭa'i tshig 'grel dang gsum yod cing / rgya sgom tshul khrims grags kyis mdzad pa'i dka' 'grel dang / gnyan phul byung pa gtsug tor rgyal pos mdzad pa'i dka' 'grel rnams ni/ lugs 'di la cis kyang dgos pa'i yi ge yin no/ /gsum pa la gong ma'i rjes 'brang dang / 'phags pa'i rjes 'brang dang / sna tshogs bsdus pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ shākya grags dang khang ston te/ /gong ma'i rjes 'brang ṭikka gnyis/

/zhes pa ltar dkar shākya grags kyis mdzad pa'i ṭikka dang / sa paṇa gyi slob ma khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i ṭikka ste/ dang po ni/ dag ldan ma bsdu ru btang ba gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi rgyud bcos ma de'i lung mang du bris pa gcig yod de rtsis su mi mdzad/ gnyis pa ni dag ljon bsres pa la gsung bgros cung zad bcug pa khyad par du 'phags pa gcig yin no zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje bsod nams dbang phyug grags/ /chos kyi seng ge gzhon nu 'bum/ /kun dga' 'od zer bkra shis dpal/ /rdo rje tshul khrims 'dre ston te/ /'phags pa'i rjes 'brangs ṭikka brgyad/ /ces gsungs te/ lo spel ba rdo rje bsod nams dang / gsal la ba dbang phyug grags dang / nyi tshe lung pa chos kyi seng ge dang / gsal la ba don mo ri pa'i mkhan po gzhon nu 'bum dang / mngon dga' ba zhang kun dga' 'od zer dang / dharmā pa la'i slob dpon dbus kyi dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal dang / brag ram gyi mkhan po rdo rje tshul khrims dang / shangs bsreg shing pa 'dre ston gyis byas pa'i ṭikka rnams so/ /gzhan yang 'phags pa'i gsung bgros zin bris su btab pa ni/ ye dang gnyan don gung pa dang / /ston gzhon rdo rje shes rab ste/ /'phags pa'i rjes 'brangs zin bris lnga/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'phags pa'i slob ma ye chen po'i zin bris dang / chung ngu gcig yod pa dang / bla ma gnyan ston tshul rgyal gyis 'phags pa'i gsung bgros dang / chos rje pa'i gsung bgros gnyis ka phul du phyin par bkod pa'i zin bris dang / skyo ston dri med kyi tsha bo gung pa dar ma ye shes kyis byas pa'i zin bris dang / cog grub ston gzhon gyis byas pa'i zin bris dang / chos rje khu dbon gnyis ka'i grwa pa zhang dkon mchog dpal gyi dbon po rdo rje shes rab kyis byas pa'i zin bris te lnga'o/ /gsum pa sna tshogs bsdus pa'i ṭikka ni/

chos rje bla ma gnas drug pa/ /'jigs med grags dang bsod nams grags/ /rgyal po dpal dang rgya ston dang / /kun gzhon kun dga' bkra shis te/ /sna tshogs bsdus pa'i ṭikka brgyad/ /ces gsungs te/ chos rje bla ma'i ṭika chen nyi ma'i 'od zer dang / chung ba snying po bsdus pa ste gnyis dang / gnas drug pas byas pa'i ṭikka slob ma la phan pa dang / nyug sgog ra ba po ston 'jigs med grags pas byas pa'i ṭikka gsum dang / jo nang pa zhang ston bsod nams grags pas byas pa'i ṭikka dang / bla ma rgyal po dpal gyis byas pa'i ṭikka lung gi phreng ba che chung gnyis dang / gzhu snyi mo ba rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus kyis rdo rje snying 'grel gtso bor byas pa'i ṭikka gcig karma dkon gzhon gyis chos rje bla ma'i ṭikka la gzhi byas pa gcig dang / theg chen chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' bkra shis kyis byas pa'i ṭikka rnams so/ /yang / tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gzungs kyi dpal/ /grags rgyal blo gros seng ge ste/ /mchan dang dag chung bsres pa bzhi/ /zhes bde ba can pa bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis byas pa dang / chos rje gzungs pas byas pa dang / bo dong brang mo che'i mkhan po grags rgyal gyis byas pa dang / gung pa blo gros seng ges byas pa dang bzhi po ni gcig la gcig bris bshus byas pa lta bu yin zhing / gzhung gi don nyi tshe ba tsam yin pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa'i rjes 'brang gi khongs su 'du yang re zhig zur du bkod do/ /gzhan yang 'di byas med pa yi/ /ṭikka zin bris dka' 'grel sogs/ /snga rabs mkhas pas sbyar ba yi/ /yig cha mang po rab tu mthong / /zhes gsungs pa ni de lta bu rab tu mang ste/ legs bshad don du gnyer zhing gzhan gyi blo gros la phrag dog med pa rnams kyis blta bar bya ba'i 'os so/ /gzhan yang 'dir ma 'dus pa'i gong ma dang 'phags pa'i rjes 'brang gi ṭikka bcu gnyis tsam gyi rnam grangs yod mod kyis/

de dag gi sdom ni paṇa chen grags rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i sdom gyi tshigs bcad mchan bshad las rtogs par bya'o/ /zhar la bshad pa'i rgyud gnyis kyi 'grel pa ni/ rdo rje gur la slob dpon lha'i rigs kyi blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa yod cing / 'di mdzad pa po ni slob dpon blo gros chen po zhes bya ba dbu ma bshes spring gi 'grel pa mdzad mkhan de dang gcig go zhes gsungs/ 'di'i gleng gzhi'i skabs na cung zad tsam ma gtogs gzhan sa lugs dang mthun no/ /yang int+ra bhu tis mdzad pa dang / nag po pas mdzad pa gnyis yod kyang / don la 'gyur khyad tsam yin no/ /sambhu ṭi la/ int+ra bhu tis mdzad pa dang / man ngag snye ma dang / gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa zhig dang gsum yod kyang lugs 'di pa dang mthun pa dang mi mthun pa ci rigs yod do/ /yang bshad rgyud gnyis la rgya 'grel yod tshul 'di la rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zin bris 'ga' zhig las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ bshad rgyud rdo rje gur la 'grel pa slob dpon int+ra bhu tis mdzad bya ba gcig dang / nag po pa chung pas mdzad pa gnyis 'gyur khyad kyis mdzad byang tha dad kyang tshig don gcig par snang bas/ 'di la rje btsun yab sras thugs rtsis shin tu che/ lha'i rigs kyi blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon shānti pa'i lugs dang mthun par gda' bas khong shānti pa'i grwa rgyud gcig yin tshod 'dug 'di pa 'grel pa de la gtso bor mi mdzad pas btang snyoms bzhag nag po pa chung ba'i 'grel pa la brten nas/ gur rgyan rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa yin/ sambu ṭi la slob dpon dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad zer ba'i 'grel pa/ zangs dkar lo tsā bas mdzad par snang / khong gi gsang mtshan la dpa' bo rdo rje bya ba yin tshod 'dug ind+ra bhu tis mdzad pa gcig snang ste shin tu gyong pas deng sang 'chad mi thub pa lung tsam las mi snang /

spyir u rgyan gyi gdan sa de rnams la int+ra bhu ti bya ba/ mi'i dbang po bya ba yin pas shin tu mang ste/ sus byas kyang bzang po yin/ a bha ya ka ras mdzad pa'i 'grel pa man ngag snye ma bya ba khyad 'phags shig snang / sngags kyi lag len rgya che ba zhig la chos skad ban spun nan ltar chad/ a bha ya ka ra sa chen dang dus mnyam yin tshod 'dug pas/ yab sras gsum la 'grel pa de dang bzang 'grel ngan 'grel gang yang med/ chos rje pas bla ma paṇa chen la dus 'khor dang gsang 'dus gsan/ bla ma paṇa chen gyi bla ma a bha ya ka ra yin pas/ des na bzang 'grel yod/ sdom gsum rab dbye sogs nas a bha ya ka ra la ther bkag ner bkag byas pas/ ngan 'grel yang yod/ phyis bu ston pa/ res 'ga' a bha ya tshad mar 'dzin zer/ res 'ga' dgag pa byas/ rang re'i bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel par lung shin tu mang par drangs yod/ gang ltar yang rje btsun yab sras rnams mthu stobs dbang phyug nas brgyud pa'i gsung rgyun dang / gzhung phran rnams la brten nas 'chad/ 'grel pa mdzad byed pa yin/ rje btsun yab sras gsum chos rje pa dang bzhi po de sa skya pa'i rtsa bdag lta bu yin par gda'/ phyis kyi rnams 'dres mar snang ste/ 'on kyang bshad srol bzang pas deng sang yang rjes 'jug rnams drag par nges so/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /spyi don gsum pa des rgyud ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul la/ spyir 'phags pa'i yul du rgyud rnams la paṇḍi ta'i sgro btags kyi 'chad tshul dang / rgyud sgrub pa'i thabs ltar du 'chad pa dang / rgyud don man ngag gi sgo nas 'chad pa'am/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bur bshad pa'am rgyud mngon par rtogs pa ltar du bshad pa'i tshul te gsum yod pa la/ dang po ni sgra las drangs pa'i bshad pa gtso bor byas pa/ spyi don gyi bshad pa'am/ tshogs pa la bshad pa lta bu yin la/ gnyis pa ni rgyud kyi steng du bskyed rim gyi bshad pa tsam gtso bor byas nas 'chad pa yin te/

'di gnyis ni yang dag ma yin no/ /gsum pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'i man ngag la brten nas bshad pa phyogs re tsam ma yin par zab pa dang rgya che ba'i don mur thug pa med pa 'chad pa ste/ snying po don gsal las/ 'di mtha' 'di tsam kho nar gnas so zhes/ /de mtha' de tsam kho nar rjes dpag nas/ /'gro ba'i bla ma'i gsung las brgal ba ste/ /de na mtha' min dgongs pa dpyad par bya/ zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar yin pa las/ gangs can gyi khrod 'dir yang 'chad pa'i tshul gsum zhig 'byung ste/ 'grel byed gzhan la ma ltos par bla ma'i man ngag kho na la brten nas 'chad pa'i tshul dang / legs bsdus kyis 'chad ba'i tshul dang / bla ma'i man ngag gtso bor byas nas rgyud so so'i lugs thun mong pa rnams mi 'gal zhing / thun mong ma yin pa rnams ma 'dres par 'chad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni nā ro ta pa nas brgyud pa'i mar pa dang rngog pa'i 'chad tshul te ṭikka rin chen rgyan 'dra las/ mtsho skyes ming bzang shānti pa la sogs/ /grub thob mkhas dang mkhas su re rnams kyis/ /rgyud don ji bzhin rtogs par ma mthong nas/ /bla ma'i gsung bzhin rin chen rgyan 'dra brtsams/ /zhes bshad pas so/ /gnyis pa ni gnas drug pa blo gros mtshungs med kyis byas pa'i brtag gnyis kyi ṭikka dang / bu ston rin po che'i sambhu ṭi'i 'grel pa'i 'chad tshul rnams yin te/ de dag gi nang 'grel byed so so'i nang du 'byung ba'i legs bsdus kyi bshad pa'i rnam grangs tsam bkod nas/ rang lugs la brgyud pa 'di'i rjes su 'brang gi grub mtha' gting tshugs pa'i ngos 'dzin mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ rje btsun sa skya pa gong ma rnams kyis bshad pa'i srol bla na med pa 'di yin te/ nyi ma'i 'od zer las/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid ma nor brgyud pa kun bsdus shing / /blo gros mtshungs med gsang mdzod du ma'i lde mig can/ /rdo rje 'chang dpal sa skya pa zhes rab grags pa/

/mngon rtogs sogs mdzad rje btsun de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes 'khrul pa med pa'i brgyud pa ma lus pa'i lugs mnga' ba dang / rang gi blo gros mtshungs pa med pa'i stobs kyis gsang mdzod kyi sgo 'byed pa la rang dbang thob par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i rje btsun sa skya pa'i bshad srol 'di la/ tshul bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas rgyud 'chad pa la 'jug pa yin te/ de la tshul bzhi ni/ mdo rgyud ma lus pa'i gnas lugs rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ rgyud sde spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa/ rgyud rang rang gi ngo bo ngos gzung bar bya ba'i phyir/ rgyud kyi mtshan don/ mtshan de dang ldan pa'i rgyud bshad thabs kyi man ngag man ngag des bshad pa ltar gyi mngon rtogs pa gang zag gi rgyud la skyes pa'i rim pa ston pa/ rgyud kyi mngon rtogs pa ste tshul bzhi po 'di ni rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birwa pa'i gsung rab/ mkhas pa rnams kyi bgrod par bya ba'i 'jug ngogs/ mdo rgyud ma lus pa gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me/ bsod nams dang mi ldan pa rnams kyis rtogs par dka' ba/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa rnams kyi them skas/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa yin no/ /zhes rtogs par bya'o/ /'o na rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer las/ rgyud sde spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa mtshan gyi don bshad pa dang bcas pa/ rgyud bshad thabs kyi man ngag bstan pa dang / rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa'i skye tshul bstan pa dang / rgyud kyi gnas lugs kyi bsdus don rtogs par bya ba dang / rgyud kyi tshig dang don rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /zhes bshad thabs kyi yan lag lngar gsungs pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ mi 'gal te/ de ni spyi don dang gzhung don gnyis ka'i 'chad tshul gyi dbang du byas nas/ dang po gsum spyi don dang / phyi ma gnyis gzhung don 'chad pa'i yan lag tu sbyar ba yin pas so/ /de ltar tshul bzhi las/

dang po rgyud sde spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa la/ spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen po chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs te/ de yang spyir nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa la rgyab kyis phyogs pa mu stegs pa'i theg pa dang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa gnyis su yod de/ de ltar yang / yang dag pa rnam par grol ba'i rgyud las/ bstan pa'i tshul la'ang rnam gnyis te/ /dman gyur mu stegs theg pa dang / /mchog gyur sangs rgyas theg pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de gnyis kyi khyad par ni gsum ste/ ston pa/ lta ba/ spyod pas khyad par du gyur pa'o/ /de la mu stegs pa'i ston pa ni/ phya dang dbang phyug la sogs pa ste/ de dag ni sdug bsngal las ma grol zhing / khams gsum las ma grol ba'i sems can no/ /nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i ston pa ni/ stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa dang / sku gsum ye shes lnga dang ldan pas che ba'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /de ltar yang dpal mchog dang po las/ mtshan bzang sum cu rtsa gnyis ldan/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcus spras/ /ston pa mchog tu gyur pa'o/ /zhes pa/ lta ba khyad par du gyur pa ni/ phyi rol ba'i lta ba ni rtag chad gnyis la/ sangs rgyas pa'i lta ba ni/ bdag gnyis kas stong pa'i chos nyid spros pa dang bral ba'i/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i chos nyid ni lta ba'o/ /de ltar yang rdo rje rnam par snod pa'i rgyud las/ bdag tu lta ba rnam spangs shing / /stong nyid spros dang bral ba yis/ /dngos dang ye shes gnyis su med/ /lta ba mchog tu gyur pa'o/ /zhes so/ /spyod pa'i khyad par ni/ mu stegs pa'i spyod pa ni/ phyin ci log tu spyod pa mtshams med lnga spyod pa la sogs pa tshangs pa la sogs pa thob par 'dod pa dang / de las khyad par du gyur pa nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i spyod pa ni dge ba bcu la spyod cing /

tshad med bzhi la gnas te/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug spyod cing rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa la gnas pa'o/ /de ltar yang rdo rje dam tshig mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ dge don bcu la rab gnas shing / /tshad med bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /pha rol phyin drug spyod pa ste/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom la gnas/ /spyod pa mchog tu gyur pa'o/ /zhes so/ /nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa la gnyis te/ theg pa chung ngu dang chen po'o/ /de ltar yang dgongs pa rgyan gyi rgyud las/ rgyal ba thub pa'i theg pa tshul/ /rnam pa gnyis su yang dag bshad/ /chen po dang ni chung ngu'o/ /zhes so/ /'di gnyis kyi khyad par ni shes rab dang snying rje ste/ de yang nyan thos kyi snying rje ni/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje yin la/ theg pa chen po ni sems can la dmigs pa dang / chos la dmigs pa/ dmigs pa med pa la dmigs pa gsum gyi khyad par byas pa'o/ /shes rab kyi khyad par ni/ nyan thos kyis gang zag gi bdag med rtogs kyang chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs so/ /theg pa chen po ni bdag med gnyis ka rtogs te/ de ltar yang rnam snang mngon byang las/ snying rje sems can la dmigs shing / /shes rab chos kyi dbyings su khyab/ /theg pa chen po zhes su bshad/ /ces so/ /theg pa chen po la yang gnyis te/ mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi theg pa'o/ /de ltar yang rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ theg pa che la rnam gnyis te/ /pha rol phyin sogs theg pa dang / /rdo rje theg pa bla na med/ /ces so/ /'di gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ slob dpon tri pi ka las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas phyir/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes so/ /de'i khyad par la bzhed lugs gsum ste/ slob dpon shānti pa la sogs pa 'ga' zhig gis 'dod pa ni rgyu dang 'bras bu khyad par med la/

lam 'ba' zhig la khyad par yod par 'dod de/ gnyis ka'i rgyu rgyud rten gyi gang zag gcig ste/ gling bzhi las khyad par du 'dzam bu gling / rigs drug las mi'i lus/ dal 'byor las khyad par du 'phags pa theg pa chen po'i rigs can du skyes nas byang chub tu sems bskyed pa gcig dgos pa khyad par med do/ /'bras bu la khyad par med de gnyis ka'i sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la khyad par med do/ /yod na sangs rgyas la bzang ngan gyi skyon yod do/ /'o na gang la khyad par yod na/ lam la khyad par yod do/ /pha rol tu phyin pa tshegs che la lam bgrod pa yun ring ste/ bskal pa grangs med gsum du mgo dang mig btang ba la sogs pa dka' ba sna tshogs kyi sgo nas tshogs rdzogs dgos pas dka' ba'o/ /gsang sngags kyi theg pa ni tshegs chung yun thung la don che ba ste bde ba lam du byed pa'o/ /dbang po rab tshe 'di la/ 'bring bar do/ tha ma skye ba bdun nam/ bcu drug na sangs rgya ba'o/ /slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis bzhed pas/ rgyud dang lam la khyad par yod de/ 'bras bu la khyad par med par bzhed do/ /de yang pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa ni/ rgyu lam du byed pa ste/ spang ba'i rgyu ni mi dge ba bcu/ thob pa'i rgyu ni tshad med pa bzhi dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs te rgyu lam du byed pa'o/ /gsang sngags 'bras bu lam du byed pa ste/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can de nyid/ rnal 'byor phung po khams dang skye mched shes pa rang rig pa dang bcas pa la ldan te/ de yang phung po lnga rigs lnga'i rang bzhin/ 'byung ba lnga yul lnga'i rang bzhin/ khams dang skye mched ni byang chub sems dpa'i rang bzhin sprul pa'i sku/ de nyid rang rig cing bde ba nyams su myong ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku /de nyid rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i ngos nas chos kyi sku'o/

/de nyid sems can gyi rgyud la ldan yang / de ma rtogs pa'i bar du 'khrul pa'i stobs kyis 'khor bar 'khyam pa'o/ /gsang sngags ni thabs khyad par can la brten nas rnal 'byor pas rtogs pas 'bras bu lam du byed pa'o/ /dbang po rab tshe 'di la/ 'bring bar do/ tha ma skye ba brgyud nas sangs rgyas thob pa'o/ /des na lam la khyad par yod 'bras bu la khyad par med pa sngar bzhin no/ /slob dpon klu sgrub la sogs pa'i bzhed pas rgyu lam 'bras gsum char la khyad par yod do/ /rgyu dang lam gyi khyad par sngar bzhin no/ /de yang rdo rje rtse mo las/ gsang ba yi ni tshogs chen po/ /'di la bzhugs pa gang yin pa/ /sa thob par ni shes bya ste/ /mi ldog rgyal ba'i bdag nyid sras/ /zhes dang / sambhu ṭi las/ bskal pa bye bar rnyed dka' ba'i/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang brtson ldan pa'i/ /tshe 'di nyid la ster bas na/ /'bras bu can gyi ming gis 'bod/ /ces so/ /de ltar na rgyu las khyad par du gyur pa'o/ /lam gyi khyad par ni/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ cho ga chos dang sbyor ba las/ /gsang ba'i thar pa'i yang dag 'byung / /skye ba 'di nyid kho na la/ /rab dga' la sogs sgrub pa'i mchog /ces dang / gsang ba snying po las kyang / 'di ni gsang chen nges pa'o/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ /'di las gsang ba'i nges don med/ /ces so/ /de ltar na lam gyi khyad par byas pa'o/ /'bras bu'i khyad par ni/ mthar thug pa ni rnam gnyis te/ /'od gsal dang ni zung 'jug go /zhes so/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi gnas skabs su 'od gsal dang / zung du 'jug pa rnam pa gnyis yin pas/ 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi don pha rol tu phyin pa la yang ldan du rung ste/ zung 'jug gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi gsang sngags khyad par du 'phags te/ zung 'jug la yang gsum ste/ dngos po zung du 'jug pa/ shes bya gzung du 'jug pa dang / ye shes zung du 'jug pa'o/

/gong ma gnyis pha rol tu phyin pa la yang ldan du rung yang ye shes zung du 'jug pas gsang sngags khyad par gyur pa'o/ /de yang pha rol tu phyin pa la rgyu sngon du ma song ba la 'bras bu mi 'byung ste/ phar phyin pa la dbang bskur med pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mi rtogs so/ /des 'bras bu gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags la dbang bskur dang ldan pa'i dbang gsum pas ye shes kyi dus su rang gi sems nyid dang lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gtan la 'bebs te/ de nyid lam du khyer bas 'bras bu gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mthar phyin pa'o/ /de ltar yang dus kyi 'khor lo las/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ni/ /mthar thug gnyis med ye shes te/ /gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa'o/ /zhes dang / ye shes rnam par bkod pa'i rgyud las kyang / rdo rje theg pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /sangs rgyas drug pa rdo rje 'chang / /de nyid gnyis med rnal 'byor pas/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub bo/ /zhes sogs de'i phyir na 'bras bus khyad par du gyur pa'o/ /bla ma rdo rje gdan pas gsang sngags pa lha dang bde ba lam du byed la/ phar phyin pa la de med gsungs/ 'brog mi na re/ phar phyin pas rjes dpag lam du byed la/ gsang sngags pas mngon sum lam du byed ces gsungs/ de lta bu'i gsang sngags la dbye na gsum ste/ ngo bo dang / dbye ba dang / sgra 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /de la ngo bo ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes te/ de ltar yang rdo rje rtse mo las/ sngags rnams kun gyi mtshan nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs yin te/ /chos kyi snying po sgrub byed cing / /chos kyi dbyings dang yang dag ldan/ /sngags kyi ngo bo yin par bshad/ /ces so/ /dbye na gsum ste/ rigs sngags/ gzungs sngags/ gsang sngags so/ /de ltar yang gsang ba spyi rgyud las/

sngags rnams kun gyi dbye ba yang / /rnam pa gsum du shes bya ste/ /rigs sngags thabs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /gzungs sngags shes rab ngo bo nyid/ /gsang sngags gnyis med ye shes so/ /zhes so/ /sgra 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ mant+ra zhes pa man ni yid/ tra ni skyob pa ste/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa 'khor ba'i 'jig pa las skyob pa'i phyir na sngags so/ /de ltar yang gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ yid ni man zhes bya ba ste/ /tra ni skyob par byed pa'i don/ /yang dag sngags kyi mtshan nyid do/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i sngags de gzhi lam 'bras gsum du sbrel dgos pa'i phyir na rgyud du grub ste/ rgyud ces bya ba 'brel ba'i don/ /'grel ba de yang rnam gsum ste/ /gzhi dang rang bzhin 'bras bu'o/ /zhes dang / rdo rje rtse mo las kyang / rgyud ni rgyun chags zhes bya ste/ /'khor ba brgyud du 'dod pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i rgyud de la rgyud sde rin po che rnam pa bzhi ste/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sngags kyi rgyud/ /rnam pa bzhi ru yang dag bshad/ /ces bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud do/ /de ltar rgyud sde bzhir gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'i gzhi gang yin zhe na/ dus bzhi la dgongs nas gsungs pa'i phyir yang rgyud sde bzhir nges te/ de ltar yang lta ba thams cad yang dag par 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ rdzogs ldan gcig bya ba'i rgyud/ /gnyis ldan gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud/ /gsum ldan gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud/ /rtsod ldan gsang ba bla med rgyud/ /ces so/ /rigs bzhi la dgongs nas gsungs pa'i phyir yang bzhir nges te/ de ltar yang / gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ rigs bzhi la ni gzigs nas kyang / /rgyud sde rnam pa bzhir bshad de/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor bla na med/ /ces so/

/dbang po rab 'bring bzhi la dgongs nas kyang rgyud sde bzhir nges te/ de yang rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor rgyud/ /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la'o/ /zhes so/ /chags pa rab 'bring bzhi la dgongs nas kyang rgyud sde bzhir nges te/ de ltar yang sambu ṭi las/ blta dang rgod dang 'khrig pa dang / /gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcangs dang / /srin bu'i tshul gyi rgyud bzhir 'dod/ /ces gsungs so/ /de la rgyud sde bzhi'i khyad par ni/ bya ba'i rgyud ni don dam par chos thams cad spros pa nye bar zhi ba'i stong pa nyid la/ kun rdzob tu lha ye shes sems dpa' rje dpon la/ bdag dam tshig sems dpa' 'bangs lta bus dngos grub len pa'o/ /spyod pa'i rgyud kyi lta ba don dam par chos thams cad spros pa nye bar zhi ba'i chos nyid yin la/ kun rdzob tu lha ye shes sems dpa' dang bdag dam tshig sems dpa' mthun grogs kyi tshul gyis dngos grub len pa'o/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lta ba ni don dam par chos thams cad spros pa nye bar zhi ba'i tshig gi phyogs thams cad stong pa yin la/ kun rdzob tu lha ye shes sems dpa' dang bdag dam tshig sems dpa' gnyis lcags las gser du bsgyur ba bzhin gnyis su med par byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i lta ba ni/ don dam par chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i chos nyid stong pa nyid yin la/ kun rdzob tu lha ye shes sems dpa' dang bdag dam tshig sems dpa' gnyis su med par rang bcas su yod pa de nyid gsal bar byas pas byin gyis brlabs shing dngos grub len pa'o/ /de ltar rgyud sde bzhi la gzhung tshad du yod ces na/ bya ba'i rgyud la stong phrag bzhi'o/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la stong phrag drug go /rnal 'byor rgyud la stong phrag brgyad do/

/rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud la stong phrag bcu gnyis so/ /mi rtogs pa phra mo ston pa'i rgyud sde stong phrag bzhi'o/ /de dag ni rgyud sde bzhi gcig nas gnyis su brtsis pa yin no/ /de ltar bshad pa'i rgyud sde'i rnam gzhag de rnams ni mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying pos mdzad par grags pa'i rgyud kyi spyi rnam theg pa gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba nas 'byung ba bzhin bkod pa yin mod/ 'on kyang rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa rje btsun sa skya pa'i gsung rab dang mi mthun pa cung zad snang zhing / da ni sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi dgongs pa dri ma med pa rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsung rgyun chos rje kun dga' blo gros kyis zin bris su mdzad pa'i rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag las 'byung tshul mdo tsam brjod na/ de nyid las 'di ltar byung ste/ rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa 'chad par byed pa la/ spyi don rnam par bzhag pa dang / gzhung gi don gnyis/ dang po la/ rgyud sde spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa dang / rgyud kyi mtshan don bstan pa dang / bshad thabs kyi man ngag sbyin pa dang / mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /dang po la/ phar phyin theg pa dang / gsang sngags kyi khyad par bstan pa dang / khyad par dang ldan pa'i rgyud kyi rab tu dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ slob dpon ṭi pi ta ka ma la'i tshul gsum sgron mar lung drangs par/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pa'i/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes pas phar phyin theg pa ba dang sngags gnyis/ thob bya sangs rgyas dang / rtogs bya lta ba dang / byang sems kyi spyod pa spyod pa la don gcig na yang / ma rmongs dang zhes pa lta ba rtogs pa'i thabs la ma rmongs pa yin te phar phyin theg par/ gcig dang du bral la sogs pa'i rtags kyis rtogs par bya ba ni/ gsang sngags pas kyang dang du len la/

de nyid kyi steng du 'dir khyad chos dbang gi dus su ye shes dbab pa'i cho gas gang zag dbang po rab kyis de'i tshe lta ba rtogs pa dang / gsang dbang gi dus su gtum mo'i 'bar 'dzag la sogs pas lta ba rtogs pa dang / shes rab ye shes kyi dus su dngos sam ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten nas dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes dngos su 'dren pa la sogs pa yod pas ma rmongs pa'o/ /thabs mang ba ni/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs mang ba yin te/ theg chen spyi la ni/ bskal pa grangs med gsum la sogs par mgo dang rkang lag la sogs pa btang nas dka' bas byang chub thob pa yin/ sngags su ni tshe 'di'am/ bar do'am/ skye ba bdun nam bcu drug tshun chad du sangs rgyas sgrub pa dka' ba med pa yin no/ /thun mong ba'i dngos grub la'ang / theg chen spyi las shes rab che bar 'dod na/ thos bsam gyi sgo nas bskyed pa las gzhan med do/ /sngags pas zla ba drug gam gsum du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sgom na shes rab dpag tu med par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /dka' ba med pa ni/ bde ba lam du byed pas dka' ba med pa yin te/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcangs dang / /rgod dang lta ba dag gis kyang / /rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhir ni nges/ /zhes pa bya ba'i rgyud du bltas pa'i bde ba tsam zhig yod pa yin te mdun gyi lha'i zhal phyag la sogs la sems gtad pa de tsam gyi bde ba yod/ spyod rgyud du rgod pa tsam gyis bde ba yod pa yin te/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ rnam par snang mdzad zhal 'dzum pa/ /zhes de lta bu la sems gtad pas de tsam gyi bde ba yod/ rnal 'byor rgyud du 'khyud pa tsam gyi bde ba lam du byed de/ de nyid 'dus pa las/ rdo rje rgyal po la sogs pa rnams ni gcig gi dpung par gcig gi phyag bzhag pa/ zhes pa de la sems gtad pas bde ba khyud pa tsam yod/ bla med lha yab yum zhal sbyor dngos su yod med gang yin yang dbang po gnyis sbyar ba'i bde ba tsam lam du byed pa yin/

theg chen spyir ni zhi gnas shin sbyangs kyi bde ba tsam las med la/ de ni sngags pas kyang dang du len pas spyi ma'am thun mong ba yin la/ 'dir 'dod chags rigs bzhi'i dbye bas/ de dang tshul mtshungs pa'i bde ba bzhi yod pas dka' ba med pa yin no/ /dbang po rnon po ni/ dper na mi zhig gis lha sa'i jo bo bskor ba la/ gcig gis lam thag ring pa mon mnga' ris la sogs pa bskor nas lo gsum nas slebs pa dang / gcig gis nye ba rong chung lta bu nas zhag bdun la slebs pa de/ phyi ma dbang bo rno ba bzhin/ phar phyin theg par grangs med gsum nas sangs rgyas kyi sar slebs pa las/ tshe 'di'am/ skye ba bcu drug sogs nas slebs pa sngags kyi theg pa dbang po rno ba yin no/ /gnyis pa khyad par dang ldan pa'i rgyud kyi rab tu dbye ba ni/ bde mchog rnal 'byor gsang mtha' ba rnams/ bya ba dang spyod pa dang / rnal 'byor dang pha bla na med pa dang / ma bla na med pa dang / ma'i yang ma rnal 'byor gsang mtha' zhes drug tu 'dod/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs pa rnams/ bya ba dang / rtogs pa dang / spyod pa dang / gnyis ka dang / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang lngar 'dod/ slob dpon shanti pa la sogs pa rgya gar ba phal che ba/ bya ba/ spyod pa/ rnal 'byor/ pha bla na med/ ma bla na med dang lngar 'dod/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po la sogs pa yo ga ba chen po kha cig bya ba dang / spyod pa/ rnal 'byor te gsum du 'dod/ rnal 'byor spyod dang bya dbye ba/ /zhes so/ /rnam snang sgyu dra las/ bya spyod rnal 'byor gnyis la phyi'i rgyud/ bla med la nang gi rgyud sde gnyis su 'dod/ kyai rdo rje rgyud gsum nas gsungs pa ltar/ slob dpon birwa pa dpon slob rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa rnams rgyud sde bzhir 'dod de/ rtsa rgyud las gnyis ka 'khyud dang lag bcangs dang / /rgod dang lta ba dag gis kyang / /rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhir ni nges/

/zhes dang / gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor rgyud/ /rnal 'byor chen po de ltag la/ /zhes dang / sambu ṭi las/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcangs dang / /rgod dang lta ba dag gis kyang / /srin bu'i tshul gyis rgyud bzhir nges/ /zhes bshad pa ltar ro/ /bzhi ni bya ba dang / spyod pa dang / rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor bla med do/ /bya ba'i rgyud ni rgyud sde gang du bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa med cing / mdun du lha spyan drangs nas mchod pa'i cho ga la sogs pa yod pa bdag nyid khrus dang gtsang sbra la sogs pa'i spyod pa byed pa/ de la dbye na rgyud rags pa phyed dang nyis brgya tsam gcig bod na yod/ spyod rgyud kyi mtshan gzhi rgyud sde gang du/ bdag nyid lhar skyed pa yod cing / ye shes pa dgug gzhug med pa/ dbye na rags pa dgu yod/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi mtshan gzhi/ rgyud sde gang du ye shes dgug gzhug yod cing / dbang bzhi dang rim gnyis med pa/ dbye na rags pa bcu bdun tsam yod/ rnal 'byor chen po'i mtshan gzhi dbang bzhi dang / rim pa gnyis yod pa gang yin pa de rnams yin no/ /rgyud sde bzhir gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ phyi rol mu stegs byed la rig byed bzhi yod pas rgyud sde bzhir gsungs/ sangs rgyas pa la grub mtha' bzhi yod pas bzhir gsungs/ 'dod khams pa la sbyang bya 'dod chags rigs bzhi yod pas rgyud sde bzhir gsungs/ nyams su len mkhan gang zag la mchog dman bzhi yod pas rgyud sde bzhir gsungs so/ /de yang phyi rol pa'i log spyod bzhi dang sgo bstun nas 'dod chags can dbang phyug gi rjes su 'jug pa/ 'thob bya'i 'bras bu dbang phyug la dmigs te/ rang gi ma dang sring mo la sogs pa la bag med par spyod pa de dag rjes su gzung ba'i phyir rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud gsungs te/

der lha yab yum zhal sbyor lta bu dang / dbang gsum pa'i skabs kyi phyag rgya brtag pa la sogs pa/ rgyu mtshan sna re tsam bstan pas/ kho pa sangs rgyas pa la'ang rang re dang mthun pa'i 'dod chags kyi kun tu spyod pa re re 'dug bsams nas rim gyis bstan pa la 'jug pa dang / zhe sdang can khyab 'jug gi rjes su 'jug pa/ 'thob bya'i 'bras bu khyab 'jug la dmigs te 'tshe ba chos su smra ba de dag rjes gzung ba'i phyir spyod pa'i rgyud gsungs te/ gtso bor ni 'jam dpal gsang rgyud lta bu mngon spyod kho na ston par byed pa de lta bu'i rigs can/ des mthong pa'am thos na/ rang re dang mthun pa'i sems can gsod pa la sogs pa 'dug snyam nas bstan pa la 'jug pa dang / gti mug can tshangs pa'i rjes su 'jug pa 'thob bya'i 'bras bu tshangs pa la dmigs te/ ku sha dang / tshangs skud dang / khrus la sogs pa byed pa'i rmongs pa de dag rjes su gzung ba'i phyir bya ba'i rgyud gsungs te/ der yang khrus dang gtsang sbra la sogs pa yod pas/ kho dang mthun pas mgu nas bstan pa la 'jug pa dang / rkyen snyoms pa gsum ka'i rjes su 'jug pa'i slob dpon dang 'phrad na/ 'thob bya'i 'bras bu de dag la dmigs te ma dang sring mo la spyod pa dang / 'tshe ba chos su smra ba dang / gtsang sbra chos su smra ba de dag rjes su gzung ba'i phyir rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsungs te/ de'i gtso bo ni de nyid 'dus pa yin la/ de la dum bu bzhi yod pa'i dum bu dang po 'dod chags can 'dul ba'i don du gsungs/ gnyis pa zhe sdang / gsum pa ser sna/ bzhi pa gti mug can 'dul ba'i don du gsungs so/ /de lta bu des rkyen snyoms pa de 'dul te/ sangs rgyas pa la'ang rang re dang mthun pa'i gzhung 'dug snyam nas bstan pa la 'jug pa'o/ /sangs rgyas pa la'ang grub mtha' bzhi yod pas rgyud sde bzhir bzhag ste/ bye brag tu smra ba brjod du med pa'i bdag khas len pa'i nyan thos gnas ma bu pa'i sde pa sogs dang bstun nas bya rgyud/

rdul phran phyogs kyi cha med dang / shes pa skad cig cha med bden par 'dod pa'i kha che bye smras dang / mdo sde pa dang bstun spyod rgyud/ gzung ba bden par med kyang 'dzin pa bden par 'dod pa'i sems tsam rnam bden pa dang bstun nas rnal 'byor rgyud/ gzung 'dzin gnyis ka bden par mi 'dod pa'i rnam rdzun pa dang / dbu ma pa gnyis dang bstun nas bla med kyi rgyud bzhag pa yin no/ /bu ston pa na re/ rtse mos nang pa'i gru mtha' bzhi dang sbyar te kho bos shes byed ma mthong zer ba mi 'thad de/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba las lha'i rnal 'byor gsum dang / phyi rol don du smra ba dang / rnam rig pa dang / dbu ma pa gsum la sbyar ba shes par bya'o/ /gsang sngags 'dod khams pa la gsungs pas/ 'dod khams pa la sbyang bya 'dod chags rigs bzhi yod pas rgyud sde bzhir dbye ba yin te/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa la bltas pa'i bde ba lam du byed pa/ de dang sgo bstun pa bya rgyud/ 'phrul dga' ba sogs pa rgod pa'i bde ba lam du byed pa/ de dang sgo bstun pa spyod rgyud/ dga' ldan pa sogs 'khyud pa'i bde ba lam du byed pa/ de dang sgo bstun pa rnal 'byor rgyud/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi pa sogs dang gling bzhi pa rnams dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba lam du byed pa/ de dang sgo bstun nas bla med kyi rgyud/ gang zag mchog 'bring rjes su gzung ba'i phyir rgyud sde bzhir dbye ba yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /ces gsungs/ bu rin po ches spyod pa'i rdo rjes/ dus ni rnam pa bzhi dag gis/ /rgyud ni rnam pa bzhi ru nges/ zhes pa la brten nas dus bzhi thun tshod dang bzhi/ dus 'khor gyi zhal bzhir yod pas rgyud sde bzhi nges zer ba ni/ ma dgongs pa yin te/ spyod pa'i rdo rje'i dus bzhir grangs nges pa ni/ 'dod chags rigs bzhi dbye ba kho na yin te/

rdzogs ldan la lta ba/ gnyis ldan la rgod pa/ gsum ldan la 'khyud pa/ rtsod dus la dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba lam du byed pa/ rgyud sde bzhi dang sbyar ba gong bzhin no/ /thun tshod bzhi dang sbyor ba ni ha cang thal ba yin te/ 'o na ka ba bzhi yod pas rgyud sde bzhi/ rkang pa gnyis yod pas rgyud sde gnyis yod zer ba sogs mang por 'gyur ro/ /dus 'khor gyi zhal nas/ bya spyod/ rnal 'byor/ bla med sogs gsungs zer ba ma nges pa yin te/ dus 'khor nyid du/ rtsa ba'i zhal nas shes rab kyi rgyud gsungs/ g.yas zhal nas rnal 'byor rgyud gsungs/ g.yon zhal nas bya ba la sogs pa gsungs/ rgyab zhal nas rnal 'byor rje rigs gsungs/ zhes pa 'di la shes rab kyi rgyud ni dus kyi 'khor lo nyid yin la/ rnal 'byor rgyud ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i gsang 'dus rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor de nyid yin la/ bya ba la sogs pa 'khor lo bde mchog dus 'khor lugs dang / rje rigs ni 'khor lo sdom chen yin no/ /de ltar rgyud sde bzhi las/ 'dir rnal 'byor chen po'i phyogs yin te/ de la dbye na/ rnal 'byor pha dang rnal 'byor ma/ /rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ /ces pas pha rgyud dang / ma rgyud gnyis/ pha rgyud la zla bzang gi thig le las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis/ /rgyud ni rnam pa gsum du nges/ /zhes pa/ 'dod chags can 'dul ba'i don du gsang ba 'dus pa/ de la dbye na/ rtsa rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma/ bshad rgyud la 'phags pa yab sras ltar na/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus/ dgongs pa lung ston rdo rje phreng ba/ lha mo bzhis zhus pa/ ye shes zhabs lugs pa ltar na/ bla med rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ zhe sdang can 'dul ba gshin rje gshed la/ dgra nag gzhon nu gdong drug 'jigs byed rtog pa bdun/ gti mug can 'dul ba la rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba sogs/ ma rgyud la/ mi bskyod rnam snang rin chen 'byung /

/dpag med don yod rdo rje sems/ /zhes pa ltar mi bskyod pa'i rigs la kye rdor/ bde mchog sangs rgyas thod pa/ mahā ma ya/ a ra li skor gsum/ dus 'khor/ rnam snang gi rigs la rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud gsum/ mi g.yo ba bla med du bshad pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rigs la rdo rje bdud rtsi/ 'od dpag med kyi rigs la 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rtogs pa lnga bcu pa/ ku ru kulle'i rtogs pa/ don yod grub pa'i rigs la mgon po mngon byung / sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs la ji bzhin mnyes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa/ drug ka cha mnyam pa/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ zla bzang thig le rnams da lta bod na bzhugs/ rnal 'byor pha ma gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ spyod pa'i rdo rjes/ bskyed dang rdzogs byung rim pa yis/ /rnal 'byor bskyed par shes bya ste/ /rdzogs pa rnal 'byor ma rab dran/ /zhes pa ltar sbyang gzhi skye 'chi bar do gsum yod pa'i sbyong byed tshangs pa/ 'bras bu sku gsum lam du byed pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lta bu pha rgyud/ bskyed rim de dang 'dra ba la/ rdzogs rim pha rgyud du rlung gi de nyid rdor bzlas lta bu cung zad tsam las/ bum can dang gtum mo bka' ma brtsal ba byung la/ dgyes rdor 'dir bum pa can dang / gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi sogs yod pas na ma rgyud du'ang 'gyur la/ pha rgyud der ni rags pa dbang dus kyi phyag rgya bsten pa ni yod la/ phra ba lam sgom pa'i dus kyi phyag rgya ni med pa ste/ slob dpon arya de was gsang 'dus su/ spyod pa byed pa'i tshe shes rab kyi rgyud la 'jug par bshad/ des na rgyud sde gang du bum pa can gtum mo/ shes rab ye shes sgom dus kyi phyag rgya sogs yod pa ma rgyud/ de dag med pa ni pha rgyud ces gtso che ba'i sgo nas gsungs la/ gnyis su med pa'i rgyud ni/ bla med kyi rgyud gang dang gang 'chad pa de la gnyis su med pa'i rgyud du bshad du rung ba yin/

rnal 'byor zhes pa'i sgra don ni/ bla med kyi lugs la/ rnal 'byor thabs kyi ma yin zhing / /rnal 'byor shes rab gcig pus min/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug la/ /de bzhin gshegs pas rnal 'byor bshad/ /ces thabs shes rab snyoms par sbyor bas rnal 'byor du bshad pa yin no/ /de rnams kyis rgyud thams cad kyi spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa'i bshad pa cung zad bgyis nas/ da ni kyai rdo rje'i rgyud gsum po 'di nyid gang gi phyogs yin na/ rnal 'byor ma'i phyogs/ rtsa bshad kyi dbye ba du yod ce na/ rtsa ba'i rgyud 'bum phrag bdun pa/ 'bum phrag lnga pa/ brtag pa sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ brtag pa gnyis pa/ de la bla ma pham thing pa sku mched kyi lugs/ mal lo tsā ba dpon slob rnams 'bum phrag lnga pa las bsdus pa bcu gnyis pa/ de las btus pa dgu pa/ de las btus pa gnyis pa/ zhes pa mi 'thad de/ mkha' 'gro ma dra ba sdom pa brtag pa so gnyis pa las phyung ba/ zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /mar pa dpon slob rnams 'bum phrag lnga pa la brtag pa so gnyis yod pa'i dang po gnyis yin par bzhed/ sgrub byed kyang / gleng gzhi dang / rdo rje snying po mngon byang chub/ /brtag pa'i rgyal po dang po ste/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba sdom/ /zhes bshad zer ba mi 'thad de/ gong du brtag pa bcu gnyis par/ /rgyas par bshad pa mdor bsdus so/ /zhes dang / mchod yon zhabs bsil gong ma bzhin/ /zhes bshad pas brtag pa dang po gnyis phyung ba ni ma yin no/ /'o na gang yin snyam na/ brtag pa sum cu par ni bshad/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi/ /dag pa'i snying po yongs bsdus pa/ /zhes bshad pas na 'di ni brtag pa so gcig pa dang so gnyis pa yin no/ /spyir rgyud sde la dang po'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ shākya thub pas zlos te gsungs pa dang / ma gsungs pa gnyis las/ rtsa rgyud 'bum phrag lnga'i brtag pa sum cu ni snyigs dus kyi sems can tshe thung pas/

rgyud 'bum phrag sogs thos bsam la g.yeng nas sgom pa'i ro mi myong bar gzigs nas/ rgyud rgyas pa brtag pa so gnyis yod pa'i/ dang po sum cu mi snang par byin gyis brlabs/ de dag gi tshig don mdor bsdus pa brtag pa phyi ma gnyis ma ga dhar bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i don du gzas te gsungs/ der rdo rje snying pos gleng gzhi sbyar te rgyud bsdus/ des na 'di ni bsdus rgyud kyang yin/ rtsa rgyud 'bum phrag lnga'i dum bu yang yin no/ /jo nang dus 'khor ba rnams/ bsdus rgyud pa zhes dus 'khor rtsa rgyud ma gtogs pa'i rgyud gzhan rnams la g.yog lta bur byed de ham pa ches pas lan/ kho rang gi rtsa rgyud rgyas pa yang shambha la na yod pas/ kho rang gi rgyud kyang bsdus rgyud yin pas g.yog lta bur khas len dgos so/ /de lta bu'i rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa de la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje gur ni rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta thams cad kyis zhal gyis bzhes la/ thun mong ba sambhu ṭi ni kye rdo rje'i rgyud slob dpon birwa pa dpon slob kho na bzhed do/ /yang slob dpon shes rab gsang bas bod du bsnams byon pa'i thig le skor lnga ni/ 'bum lnga'i bshad rgyud yin par mngon te/ phyag rgya chen po thig le rtsa rgyud kyi bshad rgyud/ de'i bshad rgyud ye shes thig le/ de kho na nyid sgron ma dang / ye shes snying po ni 'bum lnga'i zab pa'i gnad bsdus pa yin/ grub pa nges bstan thig le bod du 'gyur ba med pa yin nam 'gyur nas dpe yar ba yin nam da lta mi bzhugs/ des na brtag pa gnyis pa rtsa bshad gsum du byed pa de yin/ 'di bod du bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su ma 'gyur/ phyis 'gyur lo chen rin bzang gi gong tsam/ shākya brtson 'grus bya bas gur brtag gnyis bsgyur/ rdo rje gur bya ba la rdo rje gzeb zer/ lo chen gyis bsgyur ni ma bsgyur/

thugs dam du ni mdzad/ lung 'dra drangs pa las 'gyur bcos nas rdo rje dra ba zer/ shākya brtson 'grus las grwa pa kha re byung yang deng sang bka' chad nas med do/ /lo chen gyi sku tshe'i sked tsam la bla chen 'brog byon/ rgya gar du gshegs nas slob dpon shānti pa'i lugs kyi rgyud kyi bshad pa/ dge slong dpa' bo rdo rje'i lugs kyi bshad pa/ phyis bod du ga ya dha ra las rgyud dang man ngag sbyar ba sogs bshad pa mang du gsan/ rgyud 'grel phal che ba bsgyur/ de'i sku tshe'i sked tsam la mgos khug pa lha btsas kyis bla chen la rgya gar du 'gro ba'i lam du/ skad sogs phal cher gsan/ chos kyang cung zad gsan/ man ngag dgos zhus pas/ gser dgos gsungs pa la/ gser 'bul ba mnyam po rgya gar du 'gro snyam byon/ paṇḍi ta mang po la chos mang po gsan/ ga ya dha ra dang gro mor mjal/ kyai rdor rgyud gsum gsan/ 'gyur yang byas bshad sgrub kyis gtan la phab ste/ deng sang bka' chad nas mi bzhugs/ phyis ga ya dha ra las gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis rba tshab tu rgyud gsan/ 'gyur yang byas/ bshad pa'ang byas te/ deng sang bka' chad nas mi snang / yang bla chen 'brog gi drung du mar pas byon/ 'gyur g.yar nas mar pa'i bka' bzhi bya ba bsgyur ba/ gur brtag rdo rje gdan bzhi/ mahā ma ya rnams la deng sang bar du rngog lugs zhes grags pa 'di rnams yin no zhes 'byung ba yin la/ de lta bu'i rgyud sde bzhi sogs thams cad kyi mthar thug pa ni gong du bshad pa ltar bla med kyi rgyud yin zhing / de la yang pha rgyud/ ma rgyud/ gnyis med kyi rgyud dang gsum yod pa'i tshul/ rdo rje gur las/ skyes pa rnams ni 'dul ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor pha yi rgyud bshad do/ /bud med rnams ni 'dul ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ pha rgyud la skor gsum/ ma rgyud rigs drug thabs shes cha mnyam la mos pa rnams la gtso bor dgyes pa rdo rje/
